title: With review required, Close waits for Mark Reviewed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Review, not yet marked reviewed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click Mark Reviewed.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows no "Close Work Order" in the header.

Step 2:

  • The menu does not offer "Close Work Order" either.

Step 3:

  • The work order is marked reviewed and leaves Review.

Step 4:

  • "Close Work Order" is now offered where "Create invoice" would be.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R7: “If the organization requires review before completion, the work order goes through Review and Mark Reviewed first, exactly as a billable one; Close is offered where Create invoice would be.”
  • S3-N2: “If Create invoice would not be offered (review on and not yet marked, or every line declined), Close Work Order is not offered either. With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”
  • Key Decisions: “The existing Require Review Before Completion setting is the accounting review step.”
